text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Today is the day of the Fan Fest, a school event where the campus opens to the general public and various events are held. It's a day filled with joy, but for Rice Shower…

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Urgh… Of all things, why did it have to be the marathon?!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: You'll be okay! You'll get through the race super easy! Like ZOOOOM!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Exactly. As a stayer, there's no doubt you'll be able to finish the race!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: N-no, that's not what I…

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Whoa, she really is here! McQueen!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Naturally. It would be improper not to participate in campus events.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Squeee! So cool! That's the star stayer "Best Actress" for ya!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: N-now hold on! Who's been calling me that?!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: My, my. That's the assumed three-time spring Tenno Sho champion for ya!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Ohhh, not you too, Teio!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Sigh… This is a competition. A long-distance race, at that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: …Please let me focus.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Hahaha, all right then. I'll just sit back and watch.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: …Why is this happening?!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Is this not a favorable opportunity? The current lineup has made this a perfect simulation of the spring Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: B-Bourbon? But aren't you inju—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I have already executed the rehabilitation program. After running a quick system evaluation, I have judged myself capable of observing today.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Rice. You said that you would beat McQueen at the spring Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I am looking forward to measuring your growth.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: …Right.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Time is limited. Only two minutes remain until the race commences. Preparations must be completed quickly.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I-it's about to start?! Good… goodbye!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: …Oh! And please do watch me, Bourbon. I want you to see how much I've improved.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, Rice Shower's marathon event begins.

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text: The racers approach the last slope! Who will be the first to cross the finish line?!

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text: McQueen! It's McQueen! McQueen has secured an incredible first place!

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text: As for the other big contender, Rice Shower… she finishes in eighth place?! That's quite a ways back.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Pant… pant… No… it can't be!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I couldn't keep up at all! At this rate, I—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Riiice! Good job out there!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Huff… wheeze… Huh? Where's Rice?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Hm… I could have sworn she was over here a second ago…

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I need to work harder.

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text: As for the other big contender, Rice Shower… she finishes in a close second!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Pant… pant…

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Good job, Rice!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Second place, can you believe it?! We've GOT to celebrate!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Th-thanks… but…

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I've still got a long way to go…

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: S-sorry, but… I don't want to celebrate yet.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Next time I won't let anyone down!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: W-wait. Rice!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I need to work harder.
